verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a SaaS project-management tool, and a telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for it, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out, or privacy controls. The closest item, separate workspaces for sandboxing sensitive information, is an adjacent feature and does not address telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
